Grenade Launcher. Uses 40mm HE A semi-automatic Grenade Launcher with a magazine capacity of 6 rounds. Uses 40mm HE. It has nearly unrivaled damage; it is capable of defeating the majority of infantry units, including Europan Hunter Killers in a single direct hit. The Grenade Launcher's damage is partially misleading. The Grenade Launcher deals 1,000 damage on direct impact with its 40mm projectile, however deals an additional 10,000 splash damage. This (presumably) allows the Grenade Launcher to deal up to 11,000 Damage assuming optimal conditions.
